title: A Deep Learning Framework for Character Motion Synthesis and Editing
summary: Convolutional motion manifolds support high-level trajectory generation and optimization for constraints and style transfer.
limitations: Learned kinematic naturalness does not ensure exact trajectory or physical validity.

title: Learning a bidirectional mapping between human whole-body motion and natural language using deep recurrent neural networks
summary: Sequence-to-sequence RNN learns shared continuous language/motion representations without manual motion segmentation.
limitations: Single-sentence KIT evaluation does not establish arbitrary multi-action compositional generalization.

title: Language2Pose: Natural Language Grounded Pose Forecasting
summary: Joint language-to-pose embedding is trained with a short-to-long curriculum for sentence-conditioned animation.
limitations: Pose forecasting quality and human semantic ratings differ from independent simultaneous-action coverage.

title: Action-Conditioned 3D Human Motion Synthesis with Transformer VAE
summary: ACTOR samples variable-duration SMPL sequences from categorical actions using a Transformer VAE.
limitations: Fixed action vocabulary; parallel output length depends on resources. No text-composition claim.

title: TEMOS: Generating diverse human motions from textual descriptions
summary: Pairs motion VAE training with a text encoder that predicts compatible latent distributions; generates skeleton or SMPL motion.
limitations: Primary benchmark is KIT single descriptions; action transition and body-part composition need separate mechanisms.

title: Human Motion Diffusion Model
summary: MDM predicts clean motion samples in diffusion, facilitating geometric losses and text/action conditioning.
limitations: Short standalone kinematic generation provides a prior, not automatic long-sequence or physical-contact validation.

title: Executing Your Commands via Motion Diffusion in Latent Space
summary: MLD compresses motions with a VAE before conditional latent diffusion, substantially reducing denoising cost.
limitations: Compact sequence latents obscure explicit frame/body-part correspondence for direct composition.

title: T2M-GPT: Generating Human Motion from Textual Descriptions with Discrete Representations
summary: CNN VQ-VAE with EMA/code reset and a text-conditioned GPT predicts discrete motion tokens.
limitations: Autoregressive token prediction is not equivalent to robust long multi-action generation; tokenizer limits editing precision.

title: MotionDiffuse: Text-Driven Human Motion Generation with Diffusion Model
summary: Text-conditioned diffusion models human motion and provides a foundation for fine-grained guided synthesis.
limitations: Generation fidelity and semantic-control claims require matched datasets, representations and guidance settings.

title: TMR: Text-to-Motion Retrieval Using Contrastive 3D Human Motion Synthesis
summary: Adds contrastive learning to TEMOS-style synthesis to structure a shared text-motion retrieval latent space.
limitations: Retrieval alignment can miss foot sliding, contact failures or source-preservation errors; metric models are not physical evaluators.

title: Unpaired Motion Style Transfer from Video to Animation
summary: Separates motion content and style, using AdaIN and shared 2D/3D style embeddings to transfer styles from animations or videos.
limitations: Training is unpaired but uses style labels; style/content disentanglement is empirical and not a guarantee of contact preservation.

title: Skeleton-Aware Networks for Deep Motion Retargeting
summary: Skeleton-aware convolutions and pooling map homeomorphic skeletons into a common primal-skeleton motion latent space.
limitations: Assumes homeomorphic skeleton graphs; arbitrary topology and contact/mesh consistency are separate problems.

title: Motion Puzzle: Arbitrary Motion Style Transfer by Body Part
summary: Transfers multiple local motion styles to body parts using topology-aware features, AdaIN and attention without style labels or paired motions.
limitations: Style combination does not certify simultaneous action correctness or collision-free whole-body motion.

title: SALAD: Skeleton-aware Latent Diffusion for Text-driven Motion Generation and Editing
summary: Models joint-frame-word relationships and edits generated motion by cross-attention modulation without explicit user masks.
limitations: Zero-shot editing applies to a pretrained SALAD generator; source-motion editing and exact preservation need separate evaluation.

title: EnergyMoGen: Compositional Human Motion Generation with Energy-Based Diffusion Model in Latent Space
summary: Fuses latent-aware and semantic-aware energy terms for multi-concept motion composition, including conjunction and negation.
limitations: Energy composition and text attention are empirical control mechanisms; neither supplies a physical feasibility certificate.

title: Infinite Motion: Extended Motion Generation via Long Text Instructions
summary: Extends and reassembles text-motion data, using timestamped text for long narrative generation, local editing and independent sequence splicing.
limitations: Reassembled benchmark construction must be distinguished from newly captured continuous long-motion ground truth.
